scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p db/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && tsx db/migrate.ts up
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && tsx db/migrate.ts seed
scripts.db:setup: npm run build:shared && tsx db/migrate.ts setup
scripts.dev:simulator: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@digital-twin/simulator
scripts.dev:processor: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@digital-twin/processor
scripts.dev:twin: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@digital-twin/twin-service
scripts.dev:controller: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@digital-twin/controller
scripts.dev:analytics: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@digital-twin/analytics
